concerns.text: No task implements FR-002. The coverage section claims 'FR-002 → T001/T002 (SMILES extraction/generation, flagged)', but T001 only downloads/parses CIFs and T002 filters an already-existing `data/dataset_with_metrics.csv`. No task invokes RDKit to extract or generate canonical SMILES, and no task records the `smiles_source` (extracted/generated) flag required by FR-002 and the dataset schema. Where does `dataset_with_metrics.csv` (with SMILES and pc_raw) come from? The implementer cannot satisfy FR-002 or US-1 Acceptance Scenario 2 from these tasks.

No task computes the Packing Coefficient. FR-003/FR-010 define PC = Σ V_vdW / unit-cell volume from Bondi radii, yet T002 merely filters pre-existing `pc_raw` values in `dataset_with_metrics.csv`. The Bondi-radius PC computation (and `unit_cell_volume` extraction) has no covering task; the provenance of the target variable is unimplementable from this task list.

US-2 Acceptance Scenario 1 requires the validation report to show 'MAE ≤ 0.05 (PC units)'. T007 computes MAE but no task asserts, checks, or logs pass/fail against the 0.05 threshold, so this acceptance criterion has no covering verification.

T009 tags the threshold sweep {0.5,0.6,0.7} + Bonferroni correction to FR-008, but spec FR-008 is the HTML report requirement; no FR in the active spec authorizes the sensitivity analysis. Stale/mismatched tag — either add a covering FR to the spec or drop the FR-008 tag from T009 (T010 correctly uses FR-008 for reporting).

Constitution Principle VII mandates the permutation test results be 'logged in `results/validation_report.md`'. All tasks write only `data/artifacts/validation_report.json` (T007/T009/T010); no task produces the constitutionally required `results/validation_report.md` artifact (nor reconciles the 1,000-iteration vs 10,000-shuffle discrepancy).
